notes: Save custom boards with names and switch or edit them anytime; the board editor now supports press-and-drag to toggle cells continuously; new app icon; fixed a wrong elimination order in the in-game ranking (all players tied after a fast finish)
notes_zh: 新增自定义棋盘存档（可命名保存、随时切换与编辑）、棋盘编辑器支持按住滑动连续涂改、换用新图标；修复局中排名淘汰顺序错乱（一键终局时全部并列）
